name: smooth-scroll
summary: Attaches Lenis to the document so the whole page scrolls on inertia instead of in jumps, carried by an ordinary editorial section that reads the same with or without it.

lerp.description: Linear interpolation applied per frame. Lower is heavier. Upstream constructor default.

wheelMultiplier.description: Scale applied to wheel deltas. Upstream constructor default.

touchMultiplier.description: Scale applied to touch deltas. Upstream constructor default.

deviations.what: The document-wide Lenis instance is refcounted across mounts: a second section shares the first's instance and destroy() only tears it down when the last handle releases.
deviations.why: Smooth scroll is a property of the document, not of a section, but the effect contract's unit is a section and the scroll category routinely appears more than once on a page. Two Lenis instances on one document fight over the same scroll position.

deviations.what: Constructed with autoRaf: true rather than driving lenis.raf(time) from our own requestAnimationFrame loop.
deviations.why: Upstream added autoRaf so the loop lives inside Lenis, where destroy() already cancels it. Hand-writing the loop would be a second copy of upstream's to keep in step, and a leak the moment destroy() forgets to cancel it.

deviations.what: packages/core/lenis.css travels inside the effect's style.css instead of shipping as its own stylesheet.
deviations.why: Lenis sets its lenis-* classes on <html> and those rules are what keep a smoothed page from locking its height or letting a nested scroller steal the wheel. A registry item emits one stylesheet per effect, so they ride in it; every selector is scoped to .lenis, which nothing else sets.

deviations.what: Under prefers-reduced-motion Lenis is never constructed, rather than relying on its respectReducedMotion option.
deviations.why: respectReducedMotion stops the smoothing but leaves the wheel, touch and resize listeners installed. The contract says stay at rest, and native scrolling untouched is what that means here.
